001package com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.event.general;
002
003import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.event.AbstractQSEvent;
004import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.obj.QUser;
005import org.bukkit.Location;
006import org.bukkit.event.Event;
007import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
008
009/**
010 * Calling when player do some actions about shop
011 */
012public class ShopProtectionCheckEvent extends AbstractQSEvent {
013
014  @NotNull
015  private final QUser player;
016
017  @NotNull
018  private final Location loc;
019
020  @NotNull
021  private final Event event; // Don't use getter, we have important notice need told dev in javadoc.
022
023  @NotNull
024  private final ProtectionCheckStatus status;
025
026  /**
027   * Will call when checking protection by other plugin, This event was used to compatible with
028   * QuickShop protection checking Which will fire a FAKE BlockBreakEvent
029   *
030   * @param location Target location will execute protect check.
031   * @param status   The checking status
032   * @param event    The event will call to check the permissions.
033   * @param player   The player in was mentions in this event
034   */
035  public ShopProtectionCheckEvent(
036          @NotNull final Location location,
037          @NotNull final QUser player,
038          @NotNull final ProtectionCheckStatus status,
039          @NotNull final Event event) {
040
041    this.loc = location;
042    this.player = player;
043    this.status = status;
044    this.event = event;
045  }
046
047  /**
048   * Get the event will used for permission check. WARN: This might not only BlockBreakEvent, you
049   * should check the event type before casting.
050   *
051   * @return The protection check event.
052   */
053  @NotNull
054  public Event getEvent() {
055
056    return event;
057  }
058
059  /**
060   * Gets the location that player want do shop actions on
061   *
062   * @return location
063   */
064  public @NotNull Location getLocation() {
065
066    return this.loc;
067  }
068
069  /**
070   * Gets the player triggered this event
071   *
072   * @return player
073   */
074  public @NotNull QUser getPlayer() {
075
076    return this.player;
077  }
078
079  /**
080   * Gets the status (start to checking or ended to checking)
081   *
082   * @return The status
083   */
084  public @NotNull ProtectionCheckStatus getStatus() {
085
086    return this.status;
087  }
088}
